assumed_def: Neither the docs nor a test backs the whole rule yet.
at_empty: Every value is In effect or Default
at_empty_equal: Every value is In effect or Default, or Overridden by a source that sets the same value
attention_card_sub: Values that don't apply as set, and ones the dashboard can't work out
checked_old: Checked on Claude Code {version}, {date}. You have {installed}, so this rule is due for a new check.
ed_backup_damaged_h: Can't undo. The backup is damaged.
ed_backup_damaged_rest: Undo isn't offered because the backup at {path} is damaged. Don't restore from it.
ed_backup_damaged_t: The backup at {path} doesn't match the file it was made from, so the dashboard wrote nothing. Don't restore from that backup.
ed_backup_pruned_rest: Undo isn't offered because the backup for this change is gone.
ed_certain_note: The dashboard doesn't know the model, so the model may still lower this level.
ed_err_bad_content_type: The server refused this request because of its format.
ed_err_bad_request: The server couldn't read that request.
ed_err_bad_value: That level can't be set here. Pick low, medium, high or xhigh.
ed_err_file_missing: The settings file is gone, so there's nothing to change.
ed_err_key_missing: That line is gone from the file, so there's nothing to change.
ed_err_network: No answer from the server. Check that it's still running.
ed_err_no_change: The file already holds this value.
ed_err_not_editable: This value can't be edited here anymore. Reload the page to see what can.
ed_err_too_large: That request is too large for the server.
ed_err_unknown_edit: The server can't find that change in its history.
ed_err_unknown_project: The server doesn't know this project.
ed_fail_config_dir_t: {config_dir} doesn't exist, and the dashboard keeps its backups there. Create the folder, or restart with a --config-dir that exists, then try again.
ed_fail_t: The write to {file} failed. Check that you can write to the file, then try again.
ed_hint: The dashboard finds the line to change and shows you before it saves.
ed_last_t: Last change, {when}. Effort went from {old} to {new} in {file}.
ed_ledger_h: Couldn't write to {file}. The dashboard's record of saves is damaged.
ed_ledger_preview_t: You can't save to {file} because the dashboard's record of saves is damaged. The file is unchanged.
ed_ledger_rest_t: History for {file} shows nothing and Save isn't offered, because the dashboard's record of saves at {path} is damaged. The settings file is unchanged. Move ledger.json aside to save again. Older backups stay in that folder, but Undo can't use them.
ed_ledger_t: The file is unchanged, and trying again won't help because the dashboard can't read {path}. Move ledger.json aside, then save again. Older backups stay in that folder, but Undo can't use them.
ed_level_group_sr: Effort level for the main session
ed_levels_model_unknown: No model is set, so these levels are a best guess.
ed_levels_no_support: This model has no effort levels, so there's nothing to change here.
ed_lock_cap_later: This screen only changes effort lines, so change this cap by hand.
ed_lock_cli: The --settings flag sets this, so you can't change it here. Change what you pass to it the next time you start Claude Code.
ed_lock_default: This is Claude Code's default and no file sets it, so there's no line to change. To change it, add the setting to a settings file by hand.
ed_lock_env_file: This line is in the env block of a settings file, so you can't change it here. Edit the line by hand, then start a new session.
ed_lock_env_shell: Your shell sets this, so you can't change it here. Edit CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL in your shell profile, then start a new session.
ed_lock_flag: A command-line flag sets this, so you can't change it here. Change the flag the next time you start Claude Code.
ed_lock_hard_link: This file has a hard link, so the dashboard won't write to it. Edit the file by hand.
ed_lock_managed: Your organization manages this file, so you can't change it here. Ask your administrator to change it.
ed_lock_model: The model sets this limit, so no line can change it. Pick a level the model has.
ed_lock_model_unknown: With no model set, the dashboard can't tell if this value applies.
ed_lock_no_effort_support: This model has no effort levels, so there's nothing to change here.
ed_lock_no_key_in_file: This is a default with no line in a file, so there's nothing to change. To change it, add the setting to a settings file by hand.
ed_lock_not_editable: The dashboard can't edit this value. Edit the file by hand.
ed_lock_not_owner: Another user owns this file, so the dashboard won't write to it. Edit it by hand.
ed_lock_not_regular: This isn't a regular file, so the dashboard won't write to it. Edit it by hand.
ed_lock_symlink: This file is a symbolic link, so the dashboard won't write to it. Edit the file by hand.
ed_lock_too_large: This file is too large for the dashboard to edit. Edit it by hand.
ed_lock_unknown: The dashboard can't tell what this value is, so you can't change it here. Check the value by hand.
ed_lock_unparsed: This file isn't valid JSON, so the dashboard can't change it safely. Fix the file, then reload the page.
ed_locked: Locked. To change settings, open the link the server printed in the terminal.
ed_new_session: A change applies to a new session.
ed_no_change_note: The file already holds this value, so there's nothing to save.
ed_not_undoable: Can't undo this change. Undo works only on the newest save to a file, while the file still matches that save.
ed_nothing_yet: Nothing changes until you press Save.
ed_off: Editing is off. Start the dashboard with --allow-edits to change settings here.
ed_on: Editing is on. To change effort, click the Effort tile.
ed_raced_h: Something else changed {file} straight after this write.
ed_raced_t: The file now holds neither what you saved nor the old version. Check it by hand. The old version is at {path}.
ed_raced_undo_t: The file now holds neither the backup nor what you undid. Check it by hand. The backup is at {path}.
ed_runs: in a new session after saving
ed_runs_uncertain: {level} in a new session after saving, but the model may still lower it
ed_saved_backup: The dashboard kept a backup at {path}.
ed_saved_no_effect_t: Saved. {file} now holds {level}, but this doesn't change what a new session runs.
ed_saved_part_t: Saved. {file} now holds {level}, but a new session won't run at that level.
ed_saved_t: Saved. {file} now sets effort to {level}. This applies to a new session.
ed_saved_unknown_t: Saved. {file} now holds {level}. The dashboard can't tell what a new session runs.
ed_shared: If this project keeps its settings in git, this change goes to everyone once you commit and push it.
ed_stale_file_h: {file} changed after this preview. Nothing was saved.
ed_stale_file_t: Something else edited the file. Here's your change against what's there now.
ed_stale_gone_t: The line this preview would change is gone, so there's nothing to save.
ed_stale_trail_general_t: Another value changed, so what runs may be different now. Here's your change against what's there now.
ed_stale_trail_h: Your settings changed after this preview. Nothing was saved.
ed_stale_trail_t: {files} changed, so what runs may be different now. Here's your change against what's there now.
ed_stop_cap_t: An effort cap sits below {level}, and this screen can't change a cap. Change the cap by hand first, then pick {level} again.
ed_stop_model_t: This model has no {level} level, so it runs at {runs_as}, the highest it has below that.
ed_stop_unknown_t: The only line that could set {level} is in your user settings file. Some models read that line and others ignore it.
ed_stop_winner_t: The value below wins over every line this screen can change, so none of them can reach {level}.
ed_tbl_cap: The trail now and after saving
ed_token_h: This page can't save anymore, most likely because the server restarted.
ed_token_t: Nothing changed. Open the link the server printed in the terminal, then make the change again.
ed_undo_stale_t: Undo would also remove that edit, so it isn't offered. To go back, change the file by hand, using the backup at {path}.
ed_undone_path: To compare, run cmp on the file and {path}.
ed_undone_t: Undone. {file} is back to how it was, byte for byte. This applies to a new session.
ed_unverified_fsync_h: The file holds the change, but a power loss could lose it.
ed_unverified_fsync_t: The system couldn't confirm the write reached the disk. The version from before this write is at {path}.
ed_unverified_reread_h: Can't tell what the file holds now.
ed_unverified_reread_t: The dashboard couldn't read the file back after writing it. Check the file by hand. The version from before this write is at {path}.
ed_warn_cap_t: An effort cap sits below this level, so a new session runs at the cap. To go higher, change the cap by hand.
ed_warn_ignored_t: Claude Code doesn't read this line in this case, so the value below still decides what runs.
ed_warn_invalid_t: Claude Code doesn't accept this value here, so the value below still decides what runs.
ed_warn_model_t: This model doesn't have this level, so a new session runs at the highest level it has below that.
ed_warn_nomodel_cap_t: No model is set, and an effort cap below this level still applies, so a new session runs at the cap.
ed_warn_overridden_t: Another source wins over this line. To change what runs, change the value below.
ed_warn_part_h: Saving changes what runs, but not to what you picked.
ed_warn_unknown_t: The dashboard can't tell what this value would do, so it can't say what a new session runs.
es_missing_t: The project list points {name} at {path}, and there's no folder there. Fix the path in {config_file}, or take {name} off the list.
es_missing_usage_t: {path} no longer exists, so this usage comes from saved transcripts and pin checks may not match what {name} had. Fix the path in {config_file}, or take {name} off the list.
es_noclaude_t: {path} has no .claude folder, so no project settings, local settings, agents or rules apply here. Values come from managed settings, your user files in {config_dir}, the shell and Claude Code's defaults.
es_nouser_t: {config_dir} has no settings.json, so no user settings apply. Values come from managed settings, this project's files, the shell and Claude Code's defaults.
est_tip: Estimated from token counts at API list prices. What you pay depends on your plan.
f_action_differs: Run the installer again to update it
f_action_differs_choices: Run the installer without --yes and pick again
f_action_missing: Run the installer to add it
f_cache_note: Open the trail to see why.
files_choices_bad_t: {path} is broken, so the installer uses the repo's default model and effort for every agent. With --yes, that undoes any pick you made. Run it in a terminal without --yes and pick again.
files_choices_missing_t: {path} is missing, so the installer uses the repo's default model and effort for every agent. With --yes, that undoes any pick you made. Run it in a terminal without --yes and pick again.
files_choices_partly_t: {path} has no usable choice for {names}, so the installer uses the repo's default model and effort instead. With --yes, that undoes any pick you made. Run it in a terminal without --yes and pick again.
files_error_t: The dashboard can't work out what the installer would place, so it has nothing to compare. Check that it can read the repo's files and that each agent file there has a model line and an effort line.
files_scope: This page compares the files the installer places. It doesn't check settings.json or its hook entries, so Matches doesn't mean the hooks are wired.
footer: Read from the transcripts in {config_dir}/projects. The dashboard keeps usage fields such as tokens, model, path, branch and agent name, never message text.
hidden_desc: This value looks like a secret, so the dashboard hides it. Its source and status still show.
hit_def: Share of prompt tokens read from cache
intro_agents: Each agent's runs, tokens, estimated cost and cache, with the model and effort it ran with against its pin.
intro_agents_all: Each agent's runs, tokens, estimated cost and cache, with the model and effort it ran with.
intro_all: Usage across every project folder, listed or not, over the last {range}.
intro_all_today: Usage across every project folder, listed or not, today.
intro_attention: Values that don't apply as set, and ones the dashboard can't work out. Open one to see why.
intro_files: Files this repo installs into your Claude Code config, and whether each copy still matches.
intro_models: Usage by model, with the agents that ran on each.
intro_rules: Every rule the dashboard applies, what backs it and the Claude Code version it was checked on.
intro_sessions: Recent main sessions and the agents they spawned.
intro_settings: What each value is set to and where it comes from. Open a value to see what decides it.
intro_usage: Usage in {project} over the last {range}, read from its transcripts.
intro_usage_today: Usage in {project} today, read from its transcripts.
no_pin_note: No agent file in the folders the dashboard reads.
no_pin_sentence: The dashboard found no agent file for this agent in the folders it reads, so it can't check a pin. Built-in and plugin agents show this way.
not_priced_note: The dashboard has no list price for {model}, so totals leave it out.
p_ignored: Set here, but Claude Code doesn't read it in this case
p_invalid: Set to a value Claude Code doesn't accept
p_lowered: Runs at a lower level than it's set to
p_overridden: Set here, but another source wins
p_unknown: The dashboard can't tell what this value is
partly_priced: The dashboard has no list price for one model here, so the total leaves it out.
partly_priced_many: The dashboard has no list price for {n} models here, so the total leaves them out.
partly_priced_row: The cost for {project} leaves out {n} requests with no list price.
partly_priced_row_1: The cost for {project} leaves out 1 request with no list price.
pin_cannot_check_sentence: The dashboard can't tell what this agent should run with, so it can't check these runs against the pin.
pin_main_note: From your settings files, not an agent file.
pin_model_differs_sentence: Ran on {ran_model}, but its agent file pins {pin_model}.
pin_note: This check reads today's files, so a run from before a file change can show Differs or Pin overridden.
pin_override_model_sentence: {setting} in {file} overrides this pin, so the agent runs on {model}.
pin_override_model_sentence_line: {setting} in {file}, line {line}, overrides this pin, so the agent runs on {model}.
pin_override_sentence: {setting} in {file} overrides this pin, so the agent runs at {effort}.
pin_override_sentence_line: {setting} in {file}, line {line}, overrides this pin, so the agent runs at {effort}.
pin_runs_match_cap_sentence: These runs match the pin. Right now {setting} overrides it from {source}. maxEffortLevel caps {model} at {expected}, so new runs should use {expected}.
pin_runs_match_lowered_sentence: These runs match the pin. Right now maxEffortLevel caps {model} at {expected} from {source}, so new runs should use {expected}.
pin_runs_match_lowered_sentence_no_sourc: These runs match the pin. Right now maxEffortLevel caps {model} at {expected}, so new runs should use {expected}.
pin_runs_match_note: Ran as pinned, but another setting wins right now
pin_runs_match_sentence: These runs match the pin. Right now {setting} overrides it from {source}, so new runs should use {expected}.
pin_runs_match_sentence_no_source: These runs match the pin. Right now another setting wins, so new runs should use {expected}.
pin_runs_match_unsupported_sentence: These runs match the pin. Right now {model} has no {value} level, so new runs should use {expected}.
pin_unknown: The dashboard can't tell what this agent is pinned to.
q_agents_session: Which agents did this session start?
q_effort: How much ran at each effort level?
q_runs_time: How often does this agent run?
q_time: How did usage change over time?
q_tokens_kind: What kinds of tokens does this agent use?
read_at: Read at {time} on {date}. Reload the page to update.
refused: That folder isn't on the project list, so the dashboard won't open it here. Add it to {config_file} to see it.
rules_no_match: No rule matches “{q}” here, so clear the search to see the list again.
rules_search_label: Search rules by ID or reason
s_no_range_all_t: No session ran in any project during this range, so try a longer one.
s_no_range_longest_t: No session ran during the last 30 days.
s_no_range_t: No session ran in this project during this range, so try a longer one.
s_no_usage_t: Tokens, estimated cost and cache show here after a session runs in this project.
s_pick_project_t: This page shows one project at a time, so pick one from the Project dropdown.
s_transcripts_t: The dashboard can't find or read {path}, so it has no usage to show. Settings, Needs attention, Installed files and Rules reference still work.
set_by_block: Set by {variable} in the env block of {path}, line {line}
shell_note: Read when the dashboard started. A session from another terminal may differ.
trail_no_row: This project has no {setting} for {agent}, so there's no trail to show.
usage_wait: Reading {n} transcript files. Only the first load takes this long.
usage_wait_no_count: Reading your transcripts. Only the first load takes this long.
